Theorem
[The Sphere Theorem] 1. ch12:12.34

Every complete, simply connected Riemannian $n$-manifold that is strictly $\frac14$-pinched is homeomorphic to $S^n$.

This theorem is due to Berger and Klingenberg [Ber60, Kli61]. Its pinching constant is sharp in even dimensions because the Fubini--Study metrics are $\frac14$-pinched by section prop:complex-projective-space-curvature.
